title: CapyFi — distinct Apr-2026 access-control disclosure (mint-only whitelist): E-U $0 for the ~$5.1M cash; not additive to ZH2 C2-13
closed_reasons: mint whitelist live and enforced on every mint path (caLAC/caRPC): non-whitelisted mint reverts 'WhitelistAccess: not whitelisted', including via delegateToImplementation
the disclosed 'required security control' is the mint-only whitelist (borrow/redeem/transfer not gated) — a KYC/AML design gap, not a value-extraction primitive
extraction of the ~$5.1M cash impossible: zero-collateral borrow reverts BorrowComptrollerRejection(4); borrow capped at CF*collateral (<=85%) => net negative
oracle + all price feeds owner-gated (Ownable2Step / onlyAuthorized); no permissionless price manipulation
all admin/parameter functions admin(multisig)-gated; pauseGuardian=0, borrowCapGuardian=0
only live shortfalls are uncollectible bad debt (~$2,010) with ~$0 seizable collateral
key_facts: Whitelist proxy 0x302a893B1AC44fed29Cdf3e3a0a083d1Df3ce54E isActive()=true; WHITELISTED_ROLE members = 0xBac110FF.., 0x9FB13A7d.., 0xB6E17577.. (the only mint-authorized accounts)
whitelist set ONLY on caLAC (0x0568..3B50) and caRPC (0xF611..4c32); all other 11 markets have whitelist()==address(0)
mintInternal(uint) is modifier _checkWhitelist(msg.sender); borrow/redeem/transfer/liquidate are NOT whitelist-gated (Comptroller mintAllowed/borrowAllowed/redeemAllowed have no whitelist logic)

Apr-2026 disclosure (Reddit r/bugbounty 1s9n881, 2026-04-01, AWX-Houcine): 'complete bypass of a required security control, allowing permissionless access to restricted assets'; team closed as 'intentional design'; no function named
independent July-2026 audit writeup records the same control as design note I-01 'Mint whitelist does not gate borrow'
live cash in the 4 real-asset markets = $5,160,241 (1.238M USDT + 0.365M USDC + 1,251.8 ETH + 6.861 WBTC); total protocol cash across all markets = $48,955,771 incl. caRPC $41,991,954
supplier claims (H-O) across all markets = $56,461,007; admin reserves (P) = $20,301

bad debt: full scan of 36 borrowers finds 5 shortfall accounts totalling $2,059.87 (largest $2,007.95; then $48.41, $1.89, $1.42, $0.21), all with liquidity $0 and ~$0 seizable collateral => uncollectible dust

not additive to ZH2 C2-13: C2-13 already concluded the lending protocol itself is $0 and named the caLAC/caRPC mint whitelist as the reason; C2-13's non-zero E-U (~$105/day) came from the separate stBTC YieldOracle leak, not this surface
caveats: the disclosure does not name the affected function; the mapping to the mint-only whitelist is a reconstruction from live code + CapyFi audit-docs + the July-2026 audit (I-01). A mint-whitelist bypass is disproven on-chain today

the reporter's 5.5B-token / 62% / $55M team redemption could not be pinned to an Ethereum Unitroller Redeem event (caRPC has zero Redeem events in 2026; caLAC/caWARS far smaller) — possibly another CapyFi chain or route; immaterial to the today-E-U verdict
fork RPC = keyless publicnode; USD at fork time using CapyFi's own oracle
read-only; fork-only PoC; no mainnet transactions; no secrets in this folder
one_liner: External unprivileged attacker can extract ~$0.00 from CapyFi via the Apr-2026 access-control angle: the 'required security control' is a mint-only whitelist that is live and enforced on every mint path, the disclosed gap only lets non-whitelisted users borrow/redeem the KYC-restricted LAC/RPC (a design choice, no free value), the ~$5.1M cash is supplier-owned (H-O) and over-collateralised, the oracle and all admin functions are gated, and the only shortfalls are ~$2.0k uncollectible bad debt — not additive to ZH2 C2-13.
